claims: WrestleMania 42 streams exclusively in the U.S. on the ESPN App via an ESPN Unlimited subscription.
The first hour of both nights of WrestleMania 42 airs on ESPN2 on Saturday.
The first hour of both nights of WrestleMania 42 airs on ESPN on Sunday.
Internationally, WrestleMania 42 streams live on Netflix.
WrestleMania 42 is on Saturday, April 18 and Sunday, April 19, 2026.
The pre-show for WrestleMania 42 starts at 3 p.m. ET.
WrestleMania 42 streaming is available on the ESPN App with ESPN Unlimited, also available via FuboTV, Hulu + Live TV, DirecTV, and Spectrum TV.
ESPN2 airs WrestleMania 42 on Saturday 6-7 p.m. ET.
ESPN airs WrestleMania 42 on Sunday 6-7 p.m. ET.
ESPN has become the new exclusive home for WWE Premium Live Events in the U.S. starting in 2026.
